summary: Virginia Baptist preacher and televangelist Jerry Falwell defended segregation, founded Liberty University and the Moral Majority, and fused evangelicals into an anti-abortion, anti-gay voting bloc; his son later ran Liberty amid scandal.

evidence.note: Falwell's birth in 1933 in Lynchburg, Virginia
founds Thomas Road Baptist Church in 1956, start of main span
1958 sermon defending segregation and attacking Brown v. Board
segregation academies, IRS tax-exemption fight and Bob Jones University
Moral Majority formed in 1979 with Weyrich and Phillips
voter drive and endorsement of Reagan in the 1980 election
blames AIDS on gay people and opposes funding for research
Larry Flynt segment: Hustler parody suit up to the Supreme Court
fatal heart attack in his office in 2007
whole third part follows Jerry Falwell Jr. and Liberty University
Liberty online program recruited aggressively, likened to a diploma mill
2019 petitions and student protests against Falwell Jr.

notes: Part 3 is entirely about Jerry Falwell Jr. and Liberty University up to 2019, so covered_span ends in 2019 and reaches_present is true. Father Carey Falwell's businesses from 1915 are family background, not counted. Carey killing a worker's cat is told vividly but briefly; animal-cruelty not added.
